notes.title: PATCH 03 - Open Test Server
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!



We hope you're all having fun playing Aeon Wars Tactics on our Open Test Server! 
The team has been collecting your feedback from last month's playtest and working hard to improve the game.



You may have seen it, but we pushed a patch yesterday. This patch fixes a couple of issues some of you have experienced and brings some new features:

New Features

In-game tutorial system

Certain tutorials will pop up contextually based on the first time the player interacts with something new.

Access all tutorials via the \[Escape] Settings menu. You can also turn off the automatic tutorials in this window.

Mission Briefings

Mission briefings will automatically pop up the first time the player enters an unplayed mission. Giving clear win conditions and a bit of flavour to the encounter.

Mission briefings are accessible at any time while in a match by clicking on the top left button named Objective.

Changes

Removed the 3D space Unit Card on hover inside the Army Builder

Upgraded the Unit Card tooltip inside the Army Builder and Play Area to pull more relevant stats about the unit

Bugfixes

Fixed an issue where Mechs equipped with AOEC primary weapons would target enemies outside of their Overwatch Cone

Fixed application of Skins and Chromas to specific Models - all models should now work with their available cosmetics

Fixed an issue where throwing multiple stun grenades back to back would cause the subsequent grenades to have no effect/animation

Fixed an issue where the above bug could also cause a crash

Fixed an issue where blending between specific animations while shooting with a grenade launcher would cause the model to scale up to the size of the map

Fixed blurriness in text inside the Collector Space



Since we have made a lot of changes, this patch will delete all previously saved games. It's time to try new army rosters!

Also, we have a very rare and specific crash in the game at the moment. If you can find it and share with us your log or a video of it, you'll earn the CRASH MASTER tag in our Discord! Hint to find it: "A Light Mekatron and three Demolishers walked into a bar..."  


Keep on playing and giving us feedback through our online form or our Discord server.

We love to hear from you ❤️

notes.title: Test Server Patch 02
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Last Patch before the weekend : ) 

We hope you're all having fun playing. Please share your feedback on our Discord server; it really helps improve the game! (you can find the link to the Discord on our Steam page)

Now the fun stuff! 
This patch brings heaps of little tweaks and fixes you’ve been asking for 🤩 : 
•	more coherency in player ui  color
•	improved range and shoot previews for more visibility
•	more gameplay information on units both in the army builder and in game (try the mouse over on deploy!)

And more!!!


Keep playing and giving us feedback through our online form or Discord server. 
We love to hear from you ❤️


Soliton Team

notes.title: PATCH 01 - Aeon Wars Open Test Server during the Steam Wargames Fest
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
We hope you're all having fun playing Aeon Wars Pre-Alpha build!

You may have seen it, but we pushed a patch earlier today to fix a couple of issues some of you have experienced on the first open playtest day.

This patch aims to:
•	Fix weapon category and update ranges
•	Add fixes for shoot/move freezes
•	Add fixes and improvements to AI behaviors (🤯)
•	Fix the cursor on the intro message (it's back!)
•	Add Jump movement in Collector Space (try it over the fan! Awesome🤩)
•	Add Steam overlay (oups)
•	Update cover and obscured indicator (zoom on a target to see it!)
•	Update Capture Points to change color with status changes (yeah)

Keep on playing and giving us feedback through our online form or our Discord server. 
We love to hear from you ❤️


We'll do our best to add some fixes live during the playtest!
